summary: Backend-only Rapid Fire deep check per iter115 brief. LEVEL 1 - full regression: `python -m pytest tests -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iter115_full.xml` with the pytest.ini-configured `-n 2 --dist loadscope` finished in 652.21s (10m 52s) with 577 passed, 70 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors. The two known flakes (test_rf_shop_bot::TestBotDuel::test_bot_duel_full and test_iter66_crown_guard_lead::test_night_guard_create_and_join) both passed in this run so no isolated re-run was needed. All 70 skips are the expected ones (ffmpeg not in pod; Cup Night tests skipped after 20:00 IST; QA_PHONE/QA_PIN env-gated; opt-in pilot tests). LEVEL 2 - deep E2E via the public URL: perf_rf_probe.py ran through the full Rapid Fire surface with a TEST-perf-probe grant (catalog, profile, inbox, daily, revision, weak-topics, friends, gangs, leaderboard, history, duels, duels/live, cups/night, cups/champions, badla, feed, shop + solo sprint create/complete/get + practice-rival full 30-answer match) and every one of the 24 labels returned only 200. Server-timing p50 stays <=2.7 ms for all GETs and <=5.9 ms for the writes; the one-off 32.5 ms on catalog is the first-call JIT. Spot-checked error paths and they already have dedicated green tests in the full suite (unauthenticated writes/private reads -> 401/403: test_iter42/43; NEET -> 410: test_rf_phase4; cross-player IDOR: test_rf_phase4; 422 body validation: many iterxx; one-try-a-day daily: test_rf_daily; idempotent complete / buy: test_rf_phase4; buy with low coins: test_rf_phase4; cheer squads: test_iter69_squads; Cup Night full flow: test_iter65/66/67/68; All India daily full flow + rank order + player count: test_daily_board_ranks.py / test_rf_daily.py / test_rf_daily_pcm45.py; XP ladder rank: test_xp_ladder_ranks). LEVEL 5 - load_guard characterisation: read /app/backend/load_guard.py (defaults LAG_LIMIT=200 ms, INFLIGHT_LIMIT=500, SOCKET_LIMIT=6000, RETRY_SECONDS=5; busy() is OR-of-the-three; arena_gate is wired on POST /rf/sessions, POST /rf/duels, POST /rf/duels/join, POST /rf/challenges, POST /rf/challenges/{cid}/accept, POST /rf/cups, POST /rf/cups/night/join, POST /rf/cups/{cid}/join, POST /rf/daily/start). Ran /app/backend/tests/iter115_load_probe.py at users=25/50/100/200, each running the full lobby reads + solo sprint create&complete + practice-rival create&bot in parallel, against BOTH the public URL and localhost:8001. At the public URL users=200 produced Cloudflare 429 'Just a moment...' HTML for the write endpoints (NOT a backend response; same for every repeat); no 503 arena_busy and no backend 5xx. Against localhost (ingress bypassed) users=200 came back with 0 arena_busy, 0 429, 0 exceptions and all 2xx; snapshot during the 200-user burst showed inflight peak ~174 and lag ~10 ms (vs limits 500 / 200 ms), i.e. load_guard has ~2.8x headroom at 200 concurrent new-match hits. So legitimate traffic at these sizes is NOT getting false 503s on this preview pod, and the arena_busy 503 noted in iter114 was a one-off during the heavy xdist scale suite - not reproducible today and not triggered by this synthetic load. Data integrity on the audit DB (`python tools/db_audit.py check`): 59 XP-board players rebuilt consistently (5 tie groups), 73 finished All India Rapid runs on 2026-11-20 out of 30,002 total, 7 weak-chapter students re-weighed - final line 'ALL THE SAME'. Backend err log: one Traceback = benign starlette ClientDisconnect in /api/jl proxy (same as iter114, not RF). Load probe tests/iter115_load_probe.py cleans up its own grants/profiles on exit (TEST-iter115-* only).
action_items: No code change required. load_guard thresholds (INFLIGHT_LIMIT=500, LAG_LIMIT=200 ms, SOCKET_LIMIT=6000) are appropriate on this preview pod: a 200-concurrent new-match burst peaks at inflight~174 lag~10 ms (~2.8x and ~20x headroom). The transient 503 arena_busy seen in iter114 under the full xdist scale suite was not reproducible in today's regression; keep the suggestion from iter114 (either retry POST /api/rf/cups on 503 arena_busy inside test_iter66_crown_guard_lead::test_night_guard_create_and_join, or serialize it after test_iter73_scale via conftest's one_at_a_time lock) as a QA-only guard.
Keep perf_rf_probe.py and iter115_load_probe.py in-tree for future regression; both self-clean their TEST-* grants.

Preview backend ingress applies Cloudflare bot-protection 429 (HTML 'Just a moment...') when a single IP hammers write endpoints > ~100 concurrent. Clients in production will come from many IPs so this is not a backend defect; just worth noting so a future load run against the public URL does not mistake those 429s for a server limit.
critical_code_review_comments: load_guard.py arena_gate wiring is complete and symmetric across new-match doorways (sessions, duels, duels/join, challenges create/accept, cups create + /night/join + /{cid}/join, daily/start). Internal match actions (answers, finishes, GETs) correctly bypass the gate.
The 503 contract (JSON {detail, code:'arena_busy'}, Retry-After:5, Cache-Control:no-store) matches what the app-side `useArenaWait` holds a seat for - nothing to change.
load snapshot (/api/health/load) exposes lag/inflight/sockets/turned_away/busy and is unauthenticated for ops; no PII returned - safe.
perf_rf_probe.py confirms the hot public endpoints are all <6 ms server time under single-user; this is well within the load_guard LAG budget so lag-based busy will only fire under genuine overload.

rca_of_issue: Open iter114 P1 (transient 503 arena_busy during the xdist scale suite): not reproducible in iter115. Root-cause analysis: arena_gate raises ArenaBusy if any of lag>200 ms OR inflight>500 OR sockets>6000. Under xdist loadscope's class-pinned scheduling the scale suite test_iter73_scale.py::test_gate_answers_busy_with_retry_after intentionally drives the gate hot by injecting inflight; if test_iter66's cup-creation test happens to run on the other worker within the ~1 s window before monitor()'s EMA decays, it can see busy()==True. Mitigation: either (a) add `@pytest.mark.one_at_a_time('arena_busy')` style serialization for test_iter66_crown_guard_lead::test_night_guard_create_and_join after test_iter73_scale, or (b) in that test, retry POST /api/rf/cups once on 503+code=='arena_busy' before asserting on the 409 Cup Night guard. No change to production load_guard is justified - at 200 real concurrent new-match hits the lag stayed ~10 ms and inflight stayed ~174 (well under thresholds).
